section.p: Consider a "Select Database Deployment Type" chapter in a "Database Installation Guide" document where users need structured decision-making information before choosing a deployment model.
section.codeblock:
Select the appropriate database deployment type for the environment.

Different deployment models provide varying levels of scalability, redundancy, and operational complexity.

Select one of the available deployment options. Deployment Type Description Standalone Database Suitable for development and small test environments with minimal redundancy requirements. Primary-Replica Deployment Provides read scalability and failover support for medium-sized production environments. Clustered Deployment Provides high availability and distributed load balancing for enterprise-scale deployments.

You can determine the deployment model that best fits the operational requirements.

The appropriate database deployment strategy is selected for the environment.
section.p: Result: Use <choicetable> when users need descriptive, side-by-side comparison information to make procedural decisions between multiple options.
